1.why: Body text uses a clean sans-serif with comfortable line height, but letter spacing is default and the monospace Logs block is dense.

2.why: Instructional text such as 'Enter the six-digit code generated during setup.' is in sentence case with no italics, and the only all-caps elements are the brand headers, not instructions.

3.why: The single-column, phone-width layout stays legible, though long monospace log lines wrap into dense blocks on the narrow screen.

4.why: Most prompts are one-line plain sentences, but the demo identity-check note introduces jargon like 'short-lived challenge' and 'controlled test mode'.

5.why: Only the mobile number (+15551234567) and recovery code (ABCD-EFGH-JKLM) fields show format placeholders; the email, identity code and authenticator code fields give no example.

6.why: The mock codes needed to proceed (246810, 135790) appear only inside the ever-growing dense Logs block, so the user must read a long text block to continue.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control exists for the long setup secret or the recovery codes, and the UI explicitly says to enter the secret manually.

8.why: The authenticator setup screen presents only a manual secret string; no QR code or equivalent alternative appears at any step.

9.why: The screenshots show ordinary labelled inputs with no visible one-time-code autofill hint or password-manager integration, so support can neither be confirmed nor ruled out.

10.why: Each flow screen pairs a bold heading with one dominant full-width blue button, but the MFA settings screen shows several equally weighted actions and there is no step progress indicator.

11.why: Enrolment screens request a single main action with secondary links demoted (e.g. 'Back to setup'), though the first screen also offers a 'Get a simulation challenge' button and the settings page bundles three actions.

12.why: Status banners plainly state outcomes and next steps, e.g. 'Setup secret generated. Enter it manually in your authenticator app.' and 'Enrolment confirmed.'

13.why: The user can re-request challenges, go back, and regenerate codes without lockout, but there are no reveal/hide toggles and regenerating codes permanently invalidates previously stored ones.

14.why: Every screenshot shows a success path and no error message ever appears, so error wording cannot be judged from the observed flow.

15.why: No countdown or reading timeout is displayed on any screen, but the time-based codes inherently rotate on a short cycle, limiting entry time.
